name: Minimize
author: Akshay Bapat; derived from Mike Gardner
description: Minimize Hyprland windows into Omarchy bar chips with icons, live previews, and interactive Peek. The bar button toggles: it minimizes the focused window, and brings the last minimized window back when there is nothing to minimize.

barWidget.description: One button that minimizes and restores, plus a chip per minimized window with hover preview and right-click Peek.

schema.label: Show window titles on chips
schema.description: Off: each minimized window is its app icon only (title on hover). On: icon plus a shortened title, as upstream draws it.
